Synonyms: Standard Notice;Compact UI Notice;boundary notice copy
Definition: Notice copy stating Chirality records/governs domain-engine interactions but does not approve, validate, or own solver truth; human acceptance required before reliance.
Authoritative domain solver output; must not be owned or claimed by Chirality and is owned by the domain engine/domain tool.
Authoritative truth owned by the domain engine/domain workflow when adopted by amendment, not by Chirality.
A layer that can validate format, manifest, operation preconditions, or profile rules but does not replace professional review or acceptance or own domain truth.
Domain-engine model truth that is not agent-writable; agents may write proposals/summaries only.
Agent-writable path for proposals, summaries, and review aids, distinct from protected paths.
Record identifying candidate inputs, checks, intended changes, risks, and outputs for human review; does not apply accepted domain state until the human gate is completed.
Future-work profile defined by engine identity, optional version, protected paths, proposal paths, artifact types, operations, manifest rules, and boundary notices; no accepted generic schema yet.
A possible first fixture profile or adapter example if adopted by amendment; not Chirality core runtime behavior.
Explicit accountable-human acceptance required before applied domain operations are treated as accepted domain state or relied upon.
Posture for PKG-10 domain-engine work: provisional, requiring governed amendment and stable core boundaries before implementation.
Scope item requiring that domain outputs not imply professional approval, code compliance, external validation, or solver truth.
